# Smile Hub Clinics

> Specialist-led dental clinic in Johar Town, Lahore, Pakistan, owned and run by Dr. Abdullah Karamat (BDS, FCPS Prosthodontist, Certified Implantologist, Assistant Professor). Known for published transparent pricing, honest treatment planning ("we solve the problem, we don't sell the solution"), and specialist care for dental implants, E.max veneers, clear aligners, TMJ disorders, and full-mouth rehabilitation. Also serves overseas Pakistani patients with remote consultations before travel.

Key facts:
- Location: 599 Main Boulevard, Q Block, Phase 2, Johar Town, Lahore (next to PSO petrol pump)
- Phone/WhatsApp: +92 303 5995990 | Hours: Mon–Sat 10AM–2PM & 6–9PM
- ~200 Google reviews, 4.8+ rating. Free consultations for all treatments.
- Team: FCPS Prosthodontist (Dr. Abdullah Karamat), FCPS Endodontist (Dr. Athar Parvez), and general dentists.
- Published 2026 pricing: dental implants PKR 80,000 (Izen, Korea) / 130,000 (BioHorizons, USA) per implant+abutment; E.max veneers PKR 35,000/tooth; composite veneers PKR 12,000/tooth; clear aligners PKR 150,000–180,000 all-inclusive; TMJ soft splint PKR 15,000, deprogramming splint PKR 25,000; whitening PKR 35,000.
- Warranty: failed implant integration redone free. Implant passport provided with every implant.
- Clinical positions: no zirconia veneers (E.max only), never basal implants, root canal preferred over extraction when the tooth is savable.
